title: psychosocial factors in minimally invasive bypass surgery
summary: The minimally invasive surgical technique enables the surgeon to perform the classic procedure of a bypass operation via a small and less radical access. Other publications already indicate that the physical complications can be reduced. With this study, the psychological aspect of the less invasive procedure should be examined.
conditions: Patients who require coronary revascularization in the form of bypass surgery.

interventions.name: 150 patients who received a TCRAT at the 'Klinikum Fulda' and who consented to participate in the study. TCRAT is the minimally invasive bypass procedure.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Consecutive collection of patient data who were informed about the study and who consented to the follow-ups.
Exclusion criteria:
Patients who have received emergency surgery or combination procedures. In this case, an emergency operation is defined as a heart catheter examination of the patient followed by an operation on the same day.
